scraped.title: CPEs: Promotion of economic cooperation in Asian sub-regional initiatives
scraped.subtitle: Short formats for Central Project Evaluations – Promotion of economic cooperation in Asian sub-regional initiatives
scraped.financing: Bundesministerium für wirtschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und Entwicklung (BMZ)
scraped.clientName: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
scraped.description: Creation of Central Project Evaluation (CPE) short formats in the area of promoting economic cooperation in Asian sub-regional initiatives. Detailed evaluation reports are condensed into a summary (seven-pager) of the most important results and recommendations as well as a…
body: Creation of Central Project Evaluation (CPE) short formats in the area of promoting economic cooperation in Asian sub-regional initiatives. Detailed evaluation reports are condensed into a summary (seven-pager) of the most important results and recommendations as well as a short format "At a glance" (one-pager).
